Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo for withdrawal of the criminal petition.

Memo which is placed on record reads as under:
"The counsel for the petitioner submits as under:
That, the present petitioner intent to withdraw the above said petition on the ground that charge sheet is filed.
Hence liberty be given to challenge the charge sheet, in the interest of justice and equity."
In view of the memo, the criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.
